other_failure_modes.description: Converting string columns to pandas categorical types independently for train and test sets assigns different underlying integer codes to the same categories. Models that rely on these integer codes (like LightGBM) will receive corrupted or misaligned data during prediction if the train and test sets have different unique values.

summary: The agent implements a regression solution using 5-fold cross-validation with LightGBM and CatBoost, but completely fails to compute any validation metrics. Key failures include naive equal-weight ensembling, a lack of feature engineering, and a critical bug where categorical features are encoded independently for train and test sets, leading to mismatched category codes for LightGBM.
